bio: The Beechwood Hotel is a beautiful country house located in the small market town of North Walsham close to the Norfolk coast, and rated as one of the leading small hotels in the UK.  From 1936 Agatha Christie stayed here many times as the guest of her friends whose private home it then was, often sitting in the summer house to write. The Hotel, Restaurant and Rooms reflect the elegance of that period.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Lounge Bar which has received a double AA Rosette award.
